name: com.safetoheat/lookup
title: Safe to Heat
description: Microwave, dishwasher, oven and freezer verdicts for dishes and packaging, from safetoheat.com

tools.name: check_item
tools.description: The Safe to Heat verdict for one dish, container, wrap or package: a material (foam, plastic, glass, paper plates, parchment, foil, wax paper, cardboard takeout), a brand (Pyrex, Tupperware, Ziploc, Rubbermaid) or an everyday item (cups, meat trays, yogurt tubs, clamshells, bags, foil trays, pizza boxes, melamine, unlabeled dishes). Leave use out to get all four uses. When the answer turns on one question the site lookup asks, such as whether it is labeled or whether glass is heatproof, the result says so and lists the answers; call again with answer set. Unclear names return suggestions. Cite and link the returned url.

item.description: What the dish or package is, in plain words, a slug or a brand: "yogurt tub", "Pyrex dish", "foam meat tray", "pizza box", "melamine plate".

answer.description: Optional answer to the one follow-up question a previous result returned, such as yes, no, heatproof or plain.

tools.name: decode_symbol
tools.description: What a mark on a dish or package means, from a short description: wavy lines, dishwasher top rack, oven, snowflake, glass and fork, resin 5, triangle 1, PP 5. Resin identification codes are never heat permission, and the EU glass-and-fork mark is food-contact, not microwave approval. Text only: this tool does not take photos. Cite and link the returned url.

symbol.description: A short description of the mark, such as "wavy lines", "glass and fork" or "triangle with a 5".

tools.name: list_materials
tools.description: All eight Safe to Heat materials with their default answer and the microwave, dishwasher, oven and freezer verdicts, each with the page to cite. Set use to get just that verdict per material. Cite and link the returned url.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Safe to Heat materials, use guides, brands, symbols and how we decide. Returns titled hits with a one-line summary and the page url. Cite and link the returned url.

query.description: Words to look for, such as "foil in the microwave" or "top rack".

limit.description: How many hits to return (1 to 20).

tools.name: compare_materials
tools.description: Side-by-side verdicts for 2 to 5 Safe to Heat materials, for one use or all four, with a page to cite for each row and the materials chart. Cite and link the returned url.

items.description: A material name or slug, such as glass, parchment or plastic containers.

tools.name: check_list
tools.description: Run check_item on up to 10 item and use pairs in one call, such as a pile of leftover containers. One verdict and one page url per row. The overall verdict is the more cautious one across the rows. Cite and link the returned url.

item.description: What the dish or package is, in plain words, a slug or a brand: "yogurt tub", "Pyrex dish", "foam meat tray", "pizza box", "melamine plate".

answer.description: Optional answer to the one follow-up question a previous result returned, such as yes, no, heatproof or plain.
